task: Fix EPMCDME-15582 (Turns regression: local-only slash commands like /context, /usage, /cost, /exit, /model counted as turns) via a LOCAL_ONLY_COMMANDS denylist and wrappedCommandName() helper, folded in EPMCDME-17201 (skill-backed slash commands double-counted as both Skill and Slash Command) via a one-message lookahead in extractOrderedNamedInvocations(), then fixed two code-review findings (CR-001 lookahead not skipping isMeta/isSidechain lines, CR-002 missing bare-command-mention test) in a follow-up round.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: claude-code-otlp transcript session-signals module (countTurns / wrappedCommandName, LOCAL_ONLY_COMMANDS denylist), claude named-invocations shared module (extractOrderedNamedInvocations / nextSkillName lookahead, used by both the claude and claude-acp plugins), OTLP plugin architecture doc
component_scope.layers: Agent-Tool (session/transcript parsing shared across claude-code-otlp and claude/claude-acp plugins)

requirements_clarity.label: M
requirements_clarity.gaps: Root cause and fix approach for both regressions were precisely specified upfront (exact function, exact denylist, exact dedup rule), but the first implementation round missed two real edge cases that a code-review round had to surface: CR-001 (the one-message lookahead didn't skip isMeta/isSidechain bookkeeping lines before checking for a matching Skill call) and CR-002 (no test proving a bare <command-name> mention without its <command-message> sibling stays excluded from turns).

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Logic-correctness risk in shared turn-counting and named-invocation extraction that feeds the session-summary analytics Turns metric; no exact precedent in the codebase for the new one-message lookahead pattern (nextSkillName) used to dedupe skill-backed slash commands; a wrong lookahead silently miscounts an analytics metric rather than causing a visible failure, which is exactly the class of bug this change is itself fixing (a prior silent regression, EPMCDME-15582); the code-review round proved the risk was real by catching CR-001 before merge.
technical_risk.mitigation: Reused the existing denylist/helper shape (LOCAL_ONLY_COMMANDS + wrappedCommandName) instead of inventing new parsing; extended unit tests in session-signals.test.ts, orchestrator.test.ts, and claude-named-invocations.test.ts to cover both regressions and the two CR findings; one request-changes code-review round caught both edge cases pre-merge and the fix-up round was approved clean; QA gates (lint, typecheck, build, license) all passed with only pre-existing unrelated test flakiness noted.

key_reasoning.reason: Two previously-independent shared modules were touched in the same effort: claude-code-otlp's session-signals.ts (Turns counting) and claude's claude-named-invocations.ts (skill/command dedup), both consumed by multiple agent plugins (claude-code-otlp, claude, claude-acp) plus a docs update. Red flag applied: 'Affects multiple workflows or agents' bumped Component Scope from M to L.

The fix introduces a genuinely new pattern (one-message isMeta/isSidechain-aware lookahead, nextSkillName) with no exact precedent in the codebase, feeding an analytics metric (session Turns) where incorrect logic fails silently rather than visibly — and the task itself exists because a prior version of this logic already broke silently once. A code-review round caught a real edge-case bug (CR-001) before merge, confirming the risk was not merely theoretical.
6 files modified (2 production modules, 3 test files, 1 architecture doc), 0 new files — lands in the M band (5-7 modified files) per the guide.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M (3) to L (4): the fix touches shared session/transcript logic consumed by multiple agent plugins (claude-code-otlp, claude, claude-acp).
